disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is not substantive - it's a tool failure. Report 1 encountered API errors when trying to audit 2 of 3 files, leaving it unable to complete the review. Report 2 successfully audited all files with sound reasoning. This is a coverage failure, not a disagreement on the merits.
coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to audit .gitignore and PKGBUILD due to HTTP 400 API errors, resulting in incomplete coverage
learnings: When a model encounters API errors during file review, the audit tool should either retry the failed requests or clearly distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool failure' vs 'inconclusive due to genuine uncertainty'
The audit tool should track and report tool errors separately from security findings to avoid conflating coverage failures with security concerns
For -git packages with SKIP checksums, models should explicitly note this is standard VCS practice (as Report 2 did) to prevent future false positives
